summary.text: J.R. Roth, listed by Ballotpedia as John Roth, is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 104, which he has held since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his background as working in the tourism industry and as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Roth was born in Clare, Michigan, and graduated from Harrison High School.
He earned an associate degree from Northwestern Michigan College in 1990.
He has served on the Grand Traverse County Parks & Recreation Board.
Roth took office in the state House in 2021, succeeding Larry Inman, and for 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a three-term state representative and lifelong Northern Michigan resident with a background in tourism and recreation.
He said he has chaired a Michigan Department of Health and Human Services panel that oversees funding for children's services, including foster care, child protective services and juvenile justice.
